findings.feature: Prediction settlement accuracy, history, leaderboard, bankroll and public landing aggregates
findings.observed_behavior: A fresh database upgraded through the prior head zz10_match_statistics lacked predictions.was_correct; the landing API returned HTTP 503 with sqlite3.OperationalError. Multiple API modules query the same field.
findings.expected_behavior: The migration schema contains the nullable settlement result used by the ORM and result aggregates.
findings.user_impact: Prediction result and history endpoints can fail against databases upgraded only through the prior migration head.
findings.root_cause: ORM Prediction.was_correct had no Alembic migration; the older conditional index migration skipped the index when the column was absent.
findings.evidence: Pre-fix fresh SQLite migration ended at zz10_match_statistics and GET /api/config/public/landing returned 503. New migration test and post-fix local API test both passed.
findings.recommended_fix: Deploy zz11_prediction_settlement and verify PostgreSQL migration state plus settled/pending result reads.
findings.dependencies_and_order: Wave 1; deploy after VIT-002 code fix and before production result-route verification.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh and upgraded PostgreSQL databases contain nullable predictions.was_correct and its index.
Landing, history and accuracy endpoints return valid results for pending and settled rows.

findings.feature: Subscription plan discovery and public config router availability
findings.observed_behavior: Importing backend.main logged NameError: User is not defined in subscription.py. Main catches the import error, leaving subscription routes unavailable; config imports PLANS from that module and was unavailable as well. Existing test allowed HTTP 404.
findings.expected_behavior: Subscription and dependent config routers import and serve their declared read endpoints.
findings.user_impact: Subscription plan discovery, checkout entry points and public landing configuration can be absent while the API process still starts.
findings.root_cause: The evaluated upgrade_plan annotation referenced User without importing it.
findings.evidence: Post-fix local ASGI and Uvicorn requests returned HTTP 200; subscription payload contained four plans. Regression test now requires a successful non-empty plan response.
findings.recommended_fix: Deploy the model import and verify plan/catalog reads and provider checkout in an authorized sandbox.
findings.dependencies_and_order: Wave 1; code deploy can proceed with the settlement migration.
acceptance_criteria: Plan listing returns HTTP 200 and expected plans.
Checkout test uses payment provider sandbox only.

findings.feature: Rendered browser audit and live deployment health verification
findings.observed_behavior: Playwright Chromium exits before page creation because required shared libraries are absent. The unprivileged container has no apt metadata. The deployed smoke received HTTP 503 and subsequent direct API requests received Cloudflare HTTP 429 challenge pages.
findings.expected_behavior: A supported browser can render routes and the auditor can reach an edge-approved read-only deployment endpoint.
findings.user_impact: No production UI or live backend workflow can be certified from this run.
findings.root_cause: Container browser runtime dependencies and deployment edge access are unavailable to this audit environment; application cause is unconfirmed.
findings.evidence: 24 local Playwright cases failed before assertions; deployed Playwright had 1 failure and 2 auth-gated skips; direct live probes returned 429.
findings.recommended_fix: Run from a browser-enabled runner with required native libraries and an approved staging/production network path.
findings.dependencies_and_order: Wave 0 blocker; required before route-level production claims.
acceptance_criteria: Read-only health requests pass without edge challenge.
Screenshots and console/network evidence are captured at desktop, tablet and mobile sizes.

findings.observed_behavior: npm run lint --prefix frontend exits with eslint: not found.
findings.expected_behavior: The declared lint script resolves a checked-in ESLint version and configuration after installing workspace dependencies.
findings.user_impact: Frontend lint cannot be reproduced locally from the checked-in manifest; TypeScript/build checks remain available.
findings.root_cause: frontend/package.json defines a lint script but does not declare ESLint.
findings.evidence: npm run lint --prefix frontend returned shell error eslint: not found.
findings.recommended_fix: Choose and declare ESLint plus config in a dependency-scoped change and add the lint command to CI.
findings.dependencies_and_order: Wave 0/5 tooling; requires an approved package/lockfile update.
acceptance_criteria: Clean frozen workspace install provides eslint.
Lint command passes and runs in CI.

findings.feature: Reproducible Explorer dependency installation and build
findings.observed_behavior: npm ci refuses explorer/package-lock.json because it resolves Vite 8.3.4 and Tailwind 4.3.3 against package.json ranges for Vite 7 and Tailwind 3. A no-lock install from the manifest and subsequent production build passed.
findings.expected_behavior: The checked-in lockfile satisfies the declared manifest and npm ci plus build are deterministic.
findings.user_impact: Clean npm installs of the standalone Explorer are not reproducible; source build succeeds when dependencies resolve from its manifest.
findings.root_cause: explorer/package-lock.json is out of sync with explorer/package.json.
findings.evidence: npm ci reported Vite/Tailwind version conflicts; npm install --package-lock=false followed by npm run build passed.
findings.recommended_fix: Reconcile the Explorer lockfile to the intended manifest in a separate approved dependency change.
findings.dependencies_and_order: Wave 0/5 build reproducibility; no runtime change required.
acceptance_criteria: The locked dependency install produces a successful Explorer build.
